verdict.rationale: CrewAI AMP (the enterprise platform) documents "Webhook Streaming" to "stream real-time events and updates to your systems" and real-time execution monitoring, which covers part of pushing intermediate events outward. The evidence is a one-line enterprise feature mention, though, with no detail on event types or on token-level streaming in the open-source framework. missing for 10: token-by-token LLM output streaming, documented event types for tool calls and steps, an open-source framework streaming API or event listener docs, guidance on wiring events to a UI, and hands-on corroboration.
